subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Grand Narukami Shrine

727380101.text: Yes, that'll do. Just a quick and simple cleanup job...

727380102.text: Ah, little one, you're just in time.

727380105.text: Oh, look at you. I can tell you're thinking. "Oh no, she's going to send me off on some pain-in-the-neck errand again, isn't she?"

727380106.text: Don't worry, I was just going to say that we've finished renovating the shrine and are preparing to roll out a brand-new service.

727380107.text: Now, I haven't had the chance to announce it yet, but here you are already. Wouldn't you agree that's good timing?

727380108.text: See this offering box beside me? There's going to be another place to make wishes here soon.

727380109.text: Don't you already have fortune slips?

727380110.text: That's different. Fortune slips are about telling fortunes, whereas this... is about making wishes.

727380111.text: Now then, close your eyes, make a wish, write it down on a prayer plaque, then hang it up on this rack here, and maybe your wish will come true.

727380113.text: Of course. But as for which wishes come true... That is up to the gods who watch over us all.

727380114.text: Powerless Guuji that I am, I can only help you in mortal matters.
